snippet.title: Farwend - Official Trailer | Viking Survival Sandbox
snippet.description:
Carve your saga into the land.

Farwend is a Viking-age survival sandbox where the whole island is yours to shape. Start with nothing but a rock, then gather, craft, build and fight your way to a stone hold of your own, alone or with your clan.

⚔ Shape the land: dig, raise and level every metre of ground
🏰 Build from timber hut to hardened stone fortress
🔥 Forge copper, iron and steel into weapons and armour
🐎 Lasso and ride wild horses, raise herds and farm the land
🛡 Raid castles, crack rune vaults and bring down walls with siege machines
🌍 A new island from every seed, on PvP, PvE or PvE-C servers

▶ Play the free playtest on the Epic Games Store (until 15 March 2027): https://store.epicgames.com/p/farwend-farwend-playtest-9e8c10
▶ Release: 1 April 2027
▶ Website: https://tallyhogames.co.uk/farwend/
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/ZYxHJvxuxk
▶ Press and creators: press@tallyhogames.co.uk

#Farwend #Vikings #SurvivalGame #IndieGame #EpicGames
